requirements.description: Annual Compustat financial statements and firm identifiers for sample construction and directly defined controls: EPS changes, assets, equity, liabilities, special items, shares/price, historical SIC and CIK.

required_coverage.population: U.S. public Compustat firms with fiscal years 2000–2012, plus histories needed for lagged EPS and five-year earnings volatility.
required_coverage.detail: The baseline annual sample is 2000–2012. A five-year prior operating-earnings volatility window starts in 1995; prior-year EPS changes can also reach 1999. Helper window check: anchor 1995–2012; lookback 0 months, lead 0 months gives conservative envelope 1995–2012.

routes.mapping_notes: Exact annual Compustat fields are readable for firm/year, historical SIC, CIK, assets, earnings, special items, basic EPS excluding extraordinary items, liabilities, equity, shares and fiscal-year-end price. Source wording leaves the operating-earnings numerator, some denominators/timing, Delaware status and nonmissing-item count unresolved.

variable_coverage.construction: Fog: Gunning Fog Index for the MD&A section of the current annual report. It is 0.4 times words per sentence plus percent of complex words; words per sentence is total words divided by MD&A sentences, and complex words have at least three syllables. Reported formula: 0.4 × (words per sentence + percent of complex words). Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

MBE: Indicator equal to 1 when ΔEPS, the change in EPS from year t−1 to t, falls in the neighborhood from zero through the positive threshold; otherwise 0. The main tests use EPS before extraordinary items. Table 4 columns I, II, and III use intervals [$0, $0.01], [$0, $0.02], and [$0, $0.03], respectively. Reported formula: 1{0 ≤ ΔEPS ≤ cutoff}; 0 otherwise, with cutoff = $0.01, $0.02, or $0.03 per share in columns I–III. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

NegEarnChg: Indicator equal to 1 when ΔEPS, the change in EPS from year t−1 to t, is negative. Reported formula: 1{ΔEPS < 0}. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

Earnings: Operating earnings scaled by total assets. The research-design prose specifies beginning total assets; Appendix A specifies total assets at fiscal year-end. The denominator is therefore unresolved. The supplied text also does not operationalize the operating-earnings numerator beyond that label. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

Loss: Indicator equal to 1 when Earnings is below zero. Reported formula: 1{Earnings < 0}. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

Size: Log of market value of equity at fiscal year-end. Appendix A does not specify the log base. Reported formula: log(market value of equity at fiscal year-end). Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

MTB: Market value of equity plus book value of liabilities, divided by book value of total assets, measured at fiscal year-end. Reported formula: (market value of equity + book value of liabilities) / book value of total assets. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

Age: Number of years since the firm first appears in the CRSP monthly stock return file. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

SpecItems: Amount of special items divided by total assets; the source does not specify the total-assets timing. Reported formula: special items / total assets. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

EarnVol: Standard deviation of operating earnings during the prior five years. Reported formula: SD(operating earnings during the prior five years). Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

RetVol: Standard deviation of monthly stock returns in the prior year. Reported formula: SD(monthly stock returns in the prior year). Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

NBSeg: Natural logarithm of the number of business segments. The source does not report a zero-count handling rule. Reported formula: ln(number of business segments). Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

NGSeg: Natural logarithm of the number of geographic segments. The source does not report a zero-count handling rule. Reported formula: ln(number of geographic segments). Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

NItems: Number of Compustat items with non-missing values. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

M&A: Appendix A states that the indicator is 1 for firm-years in which the firm is an acquirer according to SDC Platinum M&A and also says “1 otherwise.” The non-acquirer coding is unclear. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

SEO: Indicator equal to 1 for firm-years with a seasoned equity offering according to SDC Global New Issues and 0 otherwise. Reported formula: 1 if firm-year has a seasoned equity offering; 0 otherwise. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

Delaware: Indicator equal to 1 if the firm is incorporated in Delaware and 0 otherwise. Reported formula: 1 if incorporated in Delaware; 0 otherwise. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

design_coverage.reason: Use Compustat firm-years 2000–2012 with the paper’s required MD&A annual report; exclude SIC 4400–5000 and 6000–6999; retain the paper’s 26,967 firm-year population and listed covariates. Match filings to fiscal-year labels by reporting period/accession.
Link EDGAR filings to Compustat using CIK/GVKEY, CRSP return history using GVKEY/PERMNO, and SDC events using historical CUSIP/CRSP/Compustat links.
Use the paper’s Fama–French 48 industry fixed effects and annual year fixed effects; the FF48 SIC mapping and firm-year assignment are required.
Standard errors are clustered by industry; the source identifies the industry classification as Fama–French 48, so the same mapping is needed for clustering.
The paper does not report regression weights.
The paper reports determinant regressions and industry-clustered standard errors, but does not identify the Table 4 Panel A estimator. Clustering does not establish OLS.
Preserve the SIC exclusions, MD&A-only Fog construction, annual Compustat/SEC filing sample, market-year variable timing, and source-defined MBE cutoff variants.

implementation_issues.description: Table 4 Panel A does not identify the regression estimator; industry-clustered standard errors do not establish OLS or another estimator.
Earnings is described as operating earnings scaled by total assets, but the numerator is not operationalized and the denominator conflicts between beginning assets and fiscal-year-end assets.
NItems counts non-missing Compustat items without identifying the item universe, so the variable cannot be reconstructed from a field list alone.
Appendix A literally says M&A equals 1 for an acquirer and “1 otherwise”; retain this source text and leave the non-acquirer coding unresolved.

The paper does not specify the log base for Size, the asset timing for SpecItems, the zero-count handling before log segment counts, or the exact fiscal-year/event-date assignment for SDC and EDGAR records.
The selected sample uses current Compustat, CRSP and SDC/SEC records; no coordinator coverage confirmation establishes historical coverage or original identifier/vintage alignment.

Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

MBE: Indicator equal to 1 when ΔEPS, the change in EPS from year t−1 to t, falls in the neighborhood from zero through the positive threshold; otherwise 0. The main tests use EPS before extraordinary items. Table 4 columns I, II, and III use intervals [$0, $0.01], [$0, $0.02], and [$0, $0.03], respectively. Reported formula: 1{0 ≤ ΔEPS ≤ cutoff}; 0 otherwise, with cutoff = $0.01, $0.02, or $0.03 per share in columns I–III. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

NegEarnChg: Indicator equal to 1 when ΔEPS, the change in EPS from year t−1 to t, is negative. Reported formula: 1{ΔEPS < 0}. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

Earnings: Operating earnings scaled by total assets. The research-design prose specifies beginning total assets; Appendix A specifies total assets at fiscal year-end. The denominator is therefore unresolved. The supplied text also does not operationalize the operating-earnings numerator beyond that label. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

Loss: Indicator equal to 1 when Earnings is below zero. Reported formula: 1{Earnings < 0}. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

Size: Log of market value of equity at fiscal year-end. Appendix A does not specify the log base. Reported formula: log(market value of equity at fiscal year-end). Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

MTB: Market value of equity plus book value of liabilities, divided by book value of total assets, measured at fiscal year-end. Reported formula: (market value of equity + book value of liabilities) / book value of total assets. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

Age: Number of years since the firm first appears in the CRSP monthly stock return file. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

SpecItems: Amount of special items divided by total assets; the source does not specify the total-assets timing. Reported formula: special items / total assets. Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

RetVol: Standard deviation of monthly stock returns in the prior year. Reported formula: SD(monthly stock returns in the prior year). Link the cited raw fields and any fit-derived parameter through the listed requirements; retain the source timing, units, scaling, and unresolved definition differences.

design_coverage.reason: Use Compustat firm-years 2000–2012 with the paper’s required MD&A annual report; exclude SIC 4400–5000 and 6000–6999; retain the paper’s 26,967 firm-year population and listed covariates. Match filings to fiscal-year labels by reporting period/accession.
Link EDGAR filings to Compustat using CIK/GVKEY, CRSP return history using GVKEY/PERMNO, and SDC events using historical CUSIP/CRSP/Compustat links.
Use the paper’s Fama–French 48 industry fixed effects and annual year fixed effects; the FF48 SIC mapping and firm-year assignment are required.
Standard errors are clustered by industry; the source identifies the industry classification as Fama–French 48, so the same mapping is needed for clustering.
The paper does not report regression weights.
The paper reports determinant regressions and industry-clustered standard errors, but does not identify the Table 4 Panel A estimator. Clustering does not establish OLS.
Preserve the SIC exclusions, MD&A-only Fog construction, annual Compustat/SEC filing sample, market-year variable timing, and source-defined MBE cutoff variants.

implementation_issues.description: Table 4 Panel A does not identify the regression estimator; industry-clustered standard errors do not establish OLS or another estimator.
Earnings is described as operating earnings scaled by total assets, but the numerator is not operationalized and the denominator conflicts between beginning assets and fiscal-year-end assets.
NItems counts non-missing Compustat items without identifying the item universe, so the variable cannot be reconstructed from a field list alone.
Appendix A literally says M&A equals 1 for an acquirer and “1 otherwise”; retain this source text and leave the non-acquirer coding unresolved.

The paper does not specify the log base for Size, the asset timing for SpecItems, the zero-count handling before log segment counts, or the exact fiscal-year/event-date assignment for SDC and EDGAR records.
The selected sample uses current Compustat, CRSP and SDC/SEC records; no coordinator coverage confirmation establishes historical coverage or original identifier/vintage alignment.

review_notes: Preserve the source’s literal M&A wording (“1 for acquirer and 1 otherwise”) as an unresolved coding conflict.
The operating-earnings numerator, denominator timing and NItems field universe remain explicit data/specification gaps; no alternative field is selected by resemblance.
The SEC and SDC routes are raw public/local routes only; they do not establish complete historical firm-year matching or MD&A section coverage.
